description: Source code for security context and key derivation functions in a 3GPP-compliant wireless communication system, including algorithm selection, key generation, and key derivation functions.

classes.name: security_context
classes.description: Class managing security algorithms, key generation, and key derivation for a network node.

methods.name: select_algorithms
methods.description: Selects preferred integrity and ciphering algorithms based on supported options.

methods.name: generate_as_keys
methods.description: Generates security keys for RRC and user plane, and logs the generated keys.

methods.name: horizontal_key_derivation
methods.description: Derives a new gNB key based on PCI and SSB-ARFCN, then regenerates associated keys.

methods.name: get_128_as_config
methods.description: Returns a truncated 128-bit security configuration for a specified domain.

methods.name: get_as_config
methods.description: Returns the full security configuration for a specified domain.
